description: Search ZeroWidth product documentation. Returns matching pages with title, slug, public URL, and a query-relevant snippet. Use this when the user asks about a ZeroWidth product (Compass, Workbench, Caliper, Prism, Ledger, Napkin, the assistant), an API behavior, or a policy. No authentication required — the docs corpus is public.

query.description: Search query — keywords or natural-language phrase.
